title: Template Studio
lead: Template packs in workspaces: edit files with linter and schema checks. Released versions are read-only.

workspaces.refreshHint: Fetch the latest base branch and recount released versions
workspaces.deleteGitHint: The clone in the Studio is deleted. The repository on the host does not change.
workspaces.deleteFolderHint: Only the Studio record is deleted; the folder on disk stays.
workspaces.emptyLead: Open a packs git repository or a folder with packs to edit templates.

create.title: New workspace
create.lead: Where the packs come from. The repository is cloned partially: only the packs folder.
create.credentialHint: Tokens are added in Settings, “Git access”. The token never goes into the clone.
create.folderHint: The repository root or the packs folder itself.
create.packsPathGitHint: The folder with packs inside the repository; “.” means the root.
create.packsPathFolderHint: Leave “packs”: the Studio finds the packs folder itself.
create.label: Name
create.labelHint: Empty: from the address or the folder name.

access.serviceHint: The branch is pushed with the instance token the administrator set up for this repository. Commits are signed by you. Forks are not available with service access.

create.tokenHelp: Which token branches and pull requests need

workspace.cloningLead: This takes up to a couple of minutes. The page updates by itself.
workspace.failedLead: Check the address and access, then retry.
workspace.pickLead: Open a file in the tree on the left: a version manifest, a document or a Jinja template.

tree.title: Files
tree.empty: The packs folder is empty so far.
tree.truncated: Too many files: not all are shown.
tree.modifiedHint: The released version folder was edited outside the Studio: it no longer matches the release registry
tree.binary: Binary file: does not open in the editor

readOnly.versionReleased: File of a released version: read-only
readOnly.releasesRegistry: Release registry: changed by the “New version” wizard

editor.formSoon: A form over YAML is coming in future releases
editor.readOnlyReleased: This version is released: its files are read-only. Edits go into a new template version.
editor.readOnlyRegistry: The “New version” wizard keeps the release registry: it is not edited by hand.
editor.binaryLead: Images, fonts and office files do not open in the code editor.

stale.title: The file changed since you opened it.
stale.deleted: The file was deleted since you opened it.
stale.diffLegend: Left: the line number in their version, right: in yours. “−” only theirs, “+” only yours.

problems.title: Problems
problems.scopeVersion: Linter and schemas of version {{version}} over saved files.
problems.scopeFile: Manifest schema over the saved file.
problems.scopeNone: This file is not checked: checks run for version files and pack manifests.
problems.released: The version is released: schema errors in it are warnings only; fixes go into a new version.

gate.title: Checks before sending
gate.lead_one: “Propose changes” stopped: {{count}} error in the pack. Fix it and propose again.
gate.lead_other: “Propose changes” stopped: {{count}} errors in the pack. Fix them and propose again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.soon: Preview is not available for this file.
preview.outside: Preview builds a template version. Open a file inside a version: the manifest, a document or a template.
preview.hint: Pick a document, data and a combination, then press “Build”. The build runs on a runner, as for projects.
preview.stale: Files changed after this build: build again to see the edits.
preview.quota: {{limit}} preview builds are already running, no more are allowed. Wait for one to finish or cancel it.
preview.noDocuments: The version has no documents to build.

error.render_failed: The pack template did not render: a Jinja error or the time limit. Details are in the log.
error.interrupted: A Studio restart interrupted the build. Build again.
error.pdf_missing: The build finished but no PDF was produced. Check the document in the log.
error.build_failed: LaTeX finished with an error. The first line starting with “!” in the log points at the spot.
error.font_missing: The build container lacks a font the document asks for. Details are in the log.
error.generic: The build failed (code {{code}}). Details are in the log.

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.lead: If you open another file, the changes to this one are lost.

git.editorDirty: The editor has an unsaved edit: it will not get into the version. Press “Save” first.

commit.title: Save version
commit.leadBranch: Commit to branch {{branch}} on your behalf.
commit.leadNoBranch: There is no branch yet: the Studio creates one and commits on your behalf.
commit.messageHint: Empty: the Studio writes the message from the changed versions. You can write your own.
commit.nothing: Nothing to save: no edits since the last version.

branch.title: Branch
branch.none: No branch: the tree is at {{base}}.
branch.auto: New branch, the Studio picks the name
branch.autoHint: The branch starts at the current commit, edits on disk stay.
branch.named: Own name or an existing branch
branch.namedHint: A new name creates a branch. The name of your earlier branch or a server branch switches to it.
branch.name: Branch name
branch.dirtyHint: Switching to an existing branch needs no unsaved edits: save a version first.

merge.upToDate: The work branch already has everything from {{base}}.
merge.conflictLead: {{base}} changes the same lines as your branch. The merge was cancelled, your branch is unchanged.
merge.conflictHint: Edit these files in your branch so they agree with the base branch, save a version and update again.

startOver.title: Start over
startOver.lead: The tree goes back to a fresh {{base}} without a branch.
startOver.remote: The Studio forgets the pull request and the pushed branch. On the hosting the branch and the request stay as they are.
startOver.done: The tree is at a fresh {{base}}.

diff.title: Changes from the base branch
diff.lead: Branch commits and edits on disk compared to {{base}}.
diff.truncated: Too many changes: only the beginning is shown.

ci.title: Hosting checks
ci.notPushed: The branch is not pushed yet.
ci.none: The hosting has not started any checks yet.
ci.polling: While checks run, the status refreshes every 30 seconds.
ci.unavailable: The hosting does not share the checks status with this access (GitLab needs read_api). See them on the hosting page.
ci.approval: GitHub waits for a repository maintainer to allow the checks to run: it does so for PRs from forks by new contributors. This is not an error in your proposal, the checks start on their own once approved. The status refreshes every 2 minutes.

fork.title: Push to a fork
fork.lead: You cannot write to this repository. The branch can go to your fork, and the pull request opens from it.
fork.create: Create a fork with my token
fork.createHint: The Studio creates a fork on GitHub and pushes the branch there.
fork.ownHint: A fork on the same server as the repository.
fork.urlHint: The same server as the repository. The Studio remembers the fork for this workspace.

reason.fork_host_mismatch: The fork must be on the same server as the repository: the token is bound to the server.
reason.fork_unavailable: The fork could not be created or found. Enter the address of your fork.

where.pr: Branch {{branch}} goes to the hosting, and a pull request (PR) into {{base}} opens.
where.mr: Branch {{branch}} goes to the hosting, and a merge request (MR) into {{base}} opens.

propose.service: The push uses the instance service access, commits are signed by you.
propose.files_one: {{count}} file differs from the base branch
propose.files_other: {{count}} files differ from the base branch
propose.titleHint: Empty: the Studio writes the title from the changed versions.
propose.descriptionHint: Goes before the summary the Studio adds itself: versions, change class, notes and checks.
propose.messageHint_one: For {{count}} unsaved edit. Empty: the Studio writes it.
propose.messageHint_other: For {{count}} unsaved edits. Empty: the Studio writes it.
propose.checksHint: Before pushing, the Studio checks the changed packs. Errors show up under “Problems”.

existing.pr: Branch updated, PR #{{number}} was already open
existing.mr: Branch updated, MR !{{number}} was already open

propose.ciHint: The hosting checks status shows up in the git bar and refreshes by itself.

access.title: Repository access
access.serviceTitle: Instance service access is in use
access.serviceLead: Branches are pushed with the token the administrator set up for this repository. Commits are signed by you, forks are not available.
access.noneLead: The workspace has no token: a public repository can be read, but a branch cannot be pushed and no pull request can be opened. Add a token in Settings, “Git access”, and create the workspace with it.
access.missing: The workspace access was removed from “Git access”. Add the token again and create the workspace with it.
access.checkLead: The template studio needs write access to the repository, pull requests and reading checks status.
access.check: Check rights for the template studio
access.newToken: Issue a token with the right permissions

official.consent: I agree that the contribution is public and goes under the repository license ({{license}})
official.consentHint: Everyone will see the PR and its commits. You are asked once for this workspace.
official.afterMerge: Official packs ship with the Studio: after the PR is merged, the new version reaches users with the next release.

merged.official: The PR is merged. The new version reaches users with the next Studio release.
merged.other: The PR is merged. To propose something else, start over from the base branch.
merged.closed: The PR was closed without merging.

official.title: Official packs
official.lead: Packs from the Studio's own repository. Edit them here and propose changes through a PR: no repository of your own is needed.
official.dialogLead: The Studio downloads only the packs folder and opens a workspace. Changes are sent only with your own GitHub account.

token.hint: The branch goes to your fork on GitHub, the PR is opened from your account.

none.lead: To propose changes you need a GitHub token. Create one, add it under Git access, then come back here.
none.steps: The token needs the packs permission profile: branch, PR and checks status. For a PR from a fork into someone else's public repository a classic token with the public_repo scope works.

classHint.patch: Fixes: texts, files, signature places. Projects get the update as a card.
classHint.minor: New things without breaking: fields, documents, checkpoints.
classHint.major: A new edition of the rules: another intake year.

create.title: New version
create.lead: Template {{pack}} / {{template}}: the base folder is copied into a beta draft.
create.baseHint: The last released version by default.
create.majorHint: YEAR.1 by the intake year, for example 2027.1.
create.copyHint: Version notes in the copy are empty, the release block is removed. The class is recalculated as you edit.

bar.first: First version of the template: nothing to compare with
bar.registeredHint: The version is in the release registry of the work branch. It becomes released after the PR is merged.
bar.numberSofter: The number is softer than the changes require: choose a number not below the minimum class.
bar.outdated: Version files changed after the release: release it again to recalculate the registry entry.
bar.released: Version {{version}} is released: its folder is only a base for a copy.
bar.modified: The released version folder differs from the release: it was edited outside the Studio or this number was already released in the main branch.
bar.saveFirst: Save the file in the editor first: the wizard step rereads the version files.

renumber.title: Version number
renumber.lead: Now {{version}}. The number follows the class of changes.
renumber.minimum: The changes require at least {{minimum}}: softer is not allowed, stricter is.
renumber.unrelease: The version is already in the branch release registry: the entry is removed, release it again under the new number.

notes.title: Notes for version {{version}}
notes.lead: What changed for students and supervisors. One item per line, ru and en in pairs.
notes.draftLead: A draft from the classifier report: edit the items as needed.
notes.parallel: ru and en need the same number of items: they go in pairs.
notes.noteHint: The number is softer than the soft rules suggest. Explain the choice: the text goes into release.note and the PR description.
notes.aiHint: The English translation is written by hand for now.

release.title: Release {{version}}
release.lead: The version becomes stable, goes into the release registry with the folder digest, and its files are closed for editing.
release.leadGit: The version becomes stable and goes into the release registry of the work branch. It becomes released after the PR is merged; until then the release can be repeated.
release.noNotes: The version has no notes: the linter will not release it without ru and en items.
release.noteMissing: The number is softer than suggested and there is no class explanation: add it in the notes.
release.setDefault: Make it the default version for new projects
release.doneGit: Version {{version}} released in the work branch. Open a PR with Propose changes.
release.taken: Number {{version}} is already released in the main branch. The edits can move to {{suggested}}.
release.lint: The version did not pass the checks: files are unchanged.

move.button: Move edits to a new version
move.title: Move edits of {{version}}
move.lead: The edits are copied into draft {{version}}. Return the released version folder to the release yourself (for example, git checkout).
move.leadGit: The edits are copied into draft {{version}}, the released version folder returns to the main branch, the release registry takes its entries.
move.notRestored: The released version folder still has the edits: return it to the release by hand.

places.title: Signature places
places.readOnly: This version is released: places are read only. Edit them in a draft version.
places.hintAnchors: Drag a box to set a place. The build has template lines: a new place snaps to the slot line, a place on a line moves relative to it.
places.hintNoAnchors: Drag a box to set a place. This build has no template lines: places on lines stand at their fallback places, and you move those.
places.aspect: The box is shown at 3:1. In a project the box height follows the signature picture.
places.stale: The version manifest changed, places are reloaded. Repeat the edit.
places.noSlots: No catalog slot applies to this document.
places.others_one: {{count}} more slot of the version does not apply to the document
places.others_other: {{count}} more slots of the version do not apply to the document

binding.missing: Line {{anchor}} is not in this build

places.where: Page {{page}}, x {{x}} mm, y {{y}} mm, width {{width}} mm
places.makeDefaultHint: The place of the document becomes the slot place for every document without its own place.
places.removeHint: The document gets the default place of the slot.
places.bindHint: The place stands relative to the template line and survives another layout.
places.unbindHint: The place stays where it is now, in millimetres.
places.defaultLoader: The version has no default place of its own.
places.entryMm: page {{page}}, x {{x}} mm, y {{y}} mm, width {{width}} mm
places.dateMissing: Mark on line {{anchor}}: the line is not in this build.
